scope: Original author records and available official metadata; descriptions restricted to verified abstract-level mechanisms. No full-text audit of all papers or exhaustive search is claimed.

entries.used_for: Deep small-filter CNN representations; no claim of a regional graph.
Residual learning and optimisation of deep visual representations.
Attention-based sequence processing; language-task results are not imported as image results.
Patch-sequence visual representation and transfer; input tokenisation differs from semantic grouping.
Training recipe and attention-based distillation as factors distinct from a region graph.
Pyramid hierarchy and progressive spatial reduction; no claim of an RS scene result.
Modernised CNN design; avoid categorical claims that all CNNs lack useful context.
Asymmetric masked reconstruction as pretraining; not an implemented objective in GAViT.
